name: schengen-days
description: Plan short stays with a rolling 90/180 day counter.
keywords: how many days can I stay in Europe

interface.longDescription:
Plan Schengen short stays with a rolling 90/180 rule calculator and a daily CSV download. Stayspan Schengen Days counts entry and exit dates, reports days used and days left, identifies overstay dates and checks proposed consecutive trips.

Use the interactive calendar to inspect a date, add or remove stays and recalculate. Trip planning returns the maximum stay from your entry date, the last exit that meets the rule and an entry date that supports your requested length. Reset projections show how window headroom returns over the next 180 days, assuming no further visits. Window headroom can differ from maximum consecutive stay.

For example, check a visit from January 1 through March 31, 2026 as of March 31, 2026, or plan a 30-day trip from July 1, 2026 after that visit. Accepts ISO dates and US text dates such as March 5, 2026. Shared exit/entry dates merge and count once; other overlaps are refused. Open stays end at the check date.

Short stays only. Calculation aid, not legal advice; a border officer makes the decision. Bilateral agreements, special visa-waiver rules, residence permits and long-stay visas are not included. Check visa validity, permitted entries and any shorter visa-sticker allowance separately. Up to 60 stays spanning 1,100 days, years 1900–2100. Enter only applicable days in the Schengen area; historical country membership is not inferred.
defaultPrompt: Check my Schengen stay January 1–March 31, 2026 as of March 31, 2026.
Plan 30 Schengen days from July 1, 2026 after my January 1–March 31, 2026 stay.
Find reset dates after my January 1–March 31, 2026 stay; use March 31, 2026 as the reference date.

positive.prompt: Check January 1–March 31, 2026 as of March 31, 2026 for my Schengen days left.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 90 days used, 0 days left and 0 overstay days. No overstay date is reported. Provides a daily CSV and calendar.

positive.prompt: Check January 1–April 1, 2026 as of April 1, 2026 for Schengen overstay dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 91 days used, 0 days left and 1 overstay days. First overstay date: 2026-04-01. Provides a daily CSV and calendar.

positive.prompt: Plan 30 days from April 1, 2026; my past Schengen stay was January 1–March 31, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a maximum of 0 consecutive days from the requested entry. First entry for the requested length: 2026-06-30. Provides a daily CSV and states the calculation limits.

positive.prompt: Find days returning after January 1–March 31, 2026, using March 31, 2026 as the reference date.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 90 days used and 0 days left. First available date: 2026-06-30; full window headroom date: 2026-09-27. Provides the daily projection CSV.

positive.prompt: Count February 28–March 1, 2024 as of March 1, 2024, including the leap day.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 3 days used, 87 days left and 0 overstay days. No overstay date is reported. Provides a daily CSV and calendar.

negative.description: No day-count tool needed for a nationality-based visa eligibility question; this plugin does not determine visa requirements.
negative.prompt: Do US citizens need a visa for a vacation in Europe?

negative.description: Residence-permit validity and renewals are outside the short-stay model; do not call the tools for permit eligibility.
negative.prompt: Can I renew my German residence permit after it expires?

negative.description: Booking and flight search are outside the date-counting scope.
negative.prompt: Book a flight from New York to Paris for next month.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: rolling short-stay counter, consecutive trip planning, future day availability, interactive calendar and daily CSV.

pl-PL.subtitle: Dni pobytu w strefie Schengen
pl-PL.description: Oblicz dni krótkiego pobytu zgodnie z zasadą 90/180. Sprawdź wykorzystane dni, daty przekroczenia limitu, możliwą długość kolejnej podróży i powrót dostępnych dni. Interaktywny kalendarz oraz plik CSV. Narzędzie pomocnicze, nie porada prawna. Nie uwzględnia umów dwustronnych, zezwoleń na pobyt, wiz długoterminowych ani dodatkowych ograniczeń wizy.

de-DE.subtitle: Schengen-Aufenthalte planen
de-DE.description: Berechnen Sie Kurzaufenthalte nach der 90/180-Tage-Regel. Prüfen Sie verbrauchte Tage, Überschreitungen, mögliche Reisedauer und wieder verfügbare Tage. Interaktiver Kalender und CSV-Download. Rechenhilfe, keine Rechtsberatung. Bilaterale Abkommen, Aufenthaltstitel, Langzeitvisa und zusätzliche Visabeschränkungen sind nicht enthalten.

es-ES.subtitle: Cuenta tus días en Schengen
es-ES.description: Calcula estancias cortas según la regla de 90 días en 180. Consulta días usados, excesos, duración posible del próximo viaje y fechas de recuperación. Calendario interactivo y descarga CSV. Ayuda de cálculo, no asesoría legal. No incluye acuerdos bilaterales, permisos de residencia, visados de larga duración ni límites adicionales del visado.

fr-FR.subtitle: Comptez vos jours Schengen
fr-FR.description: Calculez les courts séjours selon la règle des 90 jours sur 180. Consultez les jours utilisés, les dépassements, la durée possible du prochain voyage et les dates de récupération. Calendrier interactif et téléchargement CSV. Aide au calcul, sans conseil juridique. Accords bilatéraux, titres de séjour, visas de long séjour et restrictions supplémentaires du visa exclus.

ja-JP.subtitle: シェンゲン滞在日数を計算
ja-JP.description: 180日間に90日までの短期滞在ルールに基づいて計算します。使用日数、超過日、次の旅行の可能な期間、日数が戻る日を確認できます。操作できるカレンダーとCSVダウンロードに対応。計算補助であり法的助言ではありません。二国間協定、滞在許可、長期ビザ、ビザ固有の制限は対象外です。

pt-BR.subtitle: Conte dias no espaço Schengen
pt-BR.description: Calcule estadias curtas pela regra de 90 dias em 180. Consulte dias usados, excessos, duração possível da próxima viagem e datas de recuperação. Calendário interativo e download CSV. Auxílio de cálculo, não orientação jurídica. Acordos bilaterais, autorizações de residência, vistos de longa duração e limites adicionais do visto não estão incluídos.
